subject: CWE-416
object: The product reuses or references memory after it has been freed. At some point afterward, the memory may be allocated again and saved in another pointer, while the original pointer references a location somewhere within the new allocation. Any operations using the original pointer are no longer valid because the memory "belongs" to the code that operates on the new pointer.

subject: CWE-120
object: Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow')

subject: CWE-120
object: The product copies an input buffer to an output buffer without verifying that the size of the input buffer is less than the size of the output buffer.
object_canonical: the product copies an input buffer to an output buffer without verifying that the size of the input buffer is less than the size of the output buffer.
